title: Multi-Fidelity Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification and Adaptive Residual Learning for Efficient Solution of Parametric Partial Differential Equations
abstract: arXiv:2602.01176v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) by embedding physical laws directly into neural network training. However, solving high-fidelity PDEs remains computationally prohibitive, particularly for parametric systems requiring multiple evaluations across varying parameter configurations. This paper presents MF-BPINN, a novel multi-fidelity framework that synergistically combines physics-informed neural networks with Bayesian uncertainty quantification and adaptive residual learning. Our approach leverages abundant low-fidelity simulations alongside sparse high-fidelity data through a hierarchical neural architecture that learns nonlinear correlations across fidelity levels. translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）通过将物理定律直接嵌入到神经网络训练中，已成为求解偏微分方程（PDEs）的一种强大范式。然而，求解高保真PDE在计算上仍然代价高昂，特别是对于需要在多种参数配置下进行多次评估的参数化系统。本文提出了MF-BPINN，这是一种新颖的多保真框架，将物理信息神经网络与贝叶斯不确定性量化和自适应残差学习协同结合。我们的方法通过分层神经架构，利用丰富的低保真模拟与稀疏的高保真数据，学习不同保真度级别之间的非线性相关性。我们引入了一种具有可学习门控机制的自适应残差网络，能够动态平衡线性与非线性保真度差异。此外，我们还开发了一个严格的...
tldr: 本文提出MF-BPINN框架，通过融合物理信息神经网络、贝叶斯不确定性量化和自适应残差学习，利用低保真模拟与稀疏高保真数据的分层架构，实现了参数化偏微分方程的高效求解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MF-BPINN, a novel multi-fidelity framework that combines physics-informed neural networks with Bayesian uncertainty quantification and adaptive residual learning to efficiently solve parametric partial differential equations.
